bias.zh: 上升趋势 · 突破 $255.6，RSI 超买

read.en: Zscaler rose 2.1% on Oct 26 to $260.45, trading between $252.39 and $261.46, a sixth straight gain. It is above all its rising averages: 5-day ($239.8), 10-day ($228.9), 30-day ($213.5), 100-day ($172.1) and 200-day ($166.2). MACD has been above its signal since Oct 22 and above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 22 ($206.15), and RSI is 73.
read.zh: Zscaler 10月26日上涨 2.1%，收于 $260.45，盘中区间 $252.39–261.46，录得六连涨。股价位于所有上行均线上方：5 日（$239.8）、10 日（$228.9）、30 日（$213.5）、100 日（$172.1）和 200 日均线（$166.2）。MACD 自 10月22日起位于信号线及零轴上方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月22日起看多（$206.15），RSI 为 73。

read.en: The close cleared the $255.6 Oct 23 high, with RSI above 70 for a second day. Resistance is $261.5 (Oct 26 high), then $270.1 (Nov 26, 2025 high) and $289.7 (top of the Nov 26, 2025 gap). Support is $250–255.6 (Oct 23 high, round number), then $239.8–241.2 (5-day, Oct 22 high). A close above $261.5 would target $270; a close below $250 would open $240.
